intro: A spouse visa application is for husbands and wives of British citizens or settled people. We check your marriage, finances and evidence carefully before your spouse visa application goes to the Home Office.
cardText: For husbands and wives of British or settled partners.

facts.label: First grant from outside the UK

checklist.item: Your partner is British or settled

purposes.title: From outside the UK
purposes.text: Entry clearance to join your partner.

purposes.title: From inside the UK
purposes.text: Switching from another visa, where allowed.

rules.title: The financial requirement
rules.text: Most new applications need £29,000 a year from income, savings or both. Some sponsors who receive certain benefits are exempt. [Read our financial requirement guide](/spouse-visa-financial-requirement/)

rules.title: English language
rules.text: A1 for a first application, A2 when you extend, and B1 for settlement, unless you are exempt. [Read our English language guide](/english-language-requirement/)

rules.title: Route to settlement
rules.text: Partners of British citizens keep a 5-year route to Indefinite Leave to Remain under the government’s plans. [Read about the ILR changes](/ilr-changes-2026/)

rules.title: Switching from inside the UK
rules.text: You can only switch to a spouse visa from inside the UK from certain visas. Visitors usually can’t switch. We check whether you can.

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: Spouse visa application requirements
sections.text: You must both be 18 or over, legally married in a way that is recognised in the UK, have met in person, and intend to live together permanently in the UK. You also need to meet the financial, English language and accommodation requirements. Your partner must be British, Irish, settled, or have refugee status or humanitarian protection.

sections.heading: How long does a spouse visa application take?
sections.text: Applications from outside the UK are usually decided within about 12 weeks, and in-country applications within about 8 weeks, though times vary.

faqs.q: Is a religious-only marriage enough for a spouse visa application?
faqs.a: Only if the marriage is legally recognised where it took place and in UK law. We check your certificate.

faqs.q: Can I work in the UK on a spouse visa?
faqs.a: Yes. You can work and study.
You apply to extend your visa, then for settlement when you qualify.
